# Third-party notices

The MetaMask, Rabby and Phantom wallet marks in `public/wallets/` are copied from RainbowKit’s `packages/rainbowkit/src/wallets/walletConnectors/` assets. The Coinbase mark is supplied by the assignment’s pinned wallet reference. These marks identify external wallets; their owners retain their trademarks.

RainbowKit source: https://github.com/rainbow-me/rainbowkit
